title: TRL-Bench: Standardizing Cross-Paradigm Representation-Level Evaluation of Tabular Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2606.09323v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tabular encoders are usually evaluated inside task-specific end-to-end pipelines, so models from different training paradigms are difficult to compare directly even when they operate on similar tabular signals. We introduce TRL-Bench, a multi-granular tabular representation learning (TRL) benchmark that standardizes cross-paradigm representation-level evaluation: each encoder exports row-, column-, or table embeddings through its supported wrapper, and shared lightweight heads probe them across three suites: TRL-CTbench (column/table), TRL-Rbench (row), and TRL-DLTE (compositional Data-Lake Table Enrichment spanning all three granularities). To support this standardized setting, we release curated benchmark assets and task reformulations, including 50 OpenML tables with 123 verified targets, 16 row-pair linkage rewrites, and a 47,772-table DLTE lake derived from 1,379 parent tables. tldr: TRL-Bench是一个多粒度表格表示学习基准，首次通过共享轻量级探针头在行、列、表格三种粒度上标准化了不同训练范式表格编码器的跨范式表示级评估。
en_tdlr: TRL-Bench is a multi-granular tabular representation learning benchmark that, for the first time, standardizes cross-paradigm representation-level evaluation of tabular encoders across row, column, and table granularities via shared lightweight probing heads.
